question.text: The points represented by the complex number $1+i,-2+3 i, \frac{5}{3} i$ on the argand plane are

solution.text: According to question, Let find slope of $A B, B C$ and $C A$ Slope of $A B=\frac{1-3}{1-(-2)}=\frac{-2}{3}$ Slope of $B C=\frac{3-\left(\frac{5}{3}\right)}{-2-0}=\frac{-2}{3}$ Slope of $C A=\frac{\frac{5}{3}-1}{0-1}=\frac{-2}{3}$ Since, slope of all lines are same, therefore, points are collinear.
